text: pāsāṇasuttaṃ [446] ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate . tena kho pana samayena bhagavā rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ ajjhokāse nisinno hoti . devo ca ekamekaṃ phusāyati . [447] atha kho māro pāpimā bhagavato bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetukāmo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato avidūre mahante mahante pāsāṇe paggaḷesi 1 . [448] atha kho bhagavā māro ayaṃ pāpimā iti viditvā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi sacepi kevalaṃ sabbaṃ gijjhakūṭaṃ gaḷeyyasi 2 neva sammā vimuttānaṃ buddhānaṃ atthi iñjitanti . atha kho māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ bhagavā jānāti maṃ sugatoti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti . dutiyaṃ
